end.parentNote: Ananya practised estimating with a known group and checking by grouping in 10s and counting. The method worked on practice and a new-situation question. Ananya initially mixed up the number of items with how spread out they looked, then corrected this later by recognising that the same eight items remain eight when spread out. At home, spread out a small set of objects and ask, “Did the number change, or only the spacing?”
